name: Horse – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose
title: Horse – Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose Mug
story: This horse mug is for the horse girl who knows exactly where the money went: board, hay, farrier and a new halter nobody needed. A chestnut horse leans over a barn stall door chewing hay, with HORSE GIRL above and BROKE ON PURPOSE below, which makes it an easy Christmas morning coffee gift, stocking stuffer or thank-you for a barn friend.

The print is a sketched horse head with a cream and sage mane and a rust-pink coat, resting over a wooden stall door with a wisp of hay in its mouth. HORSE GIRL is set in dark brown slab capitals and BROKE ON PURPOSE below it, bold enough to read across the tack room, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose crewneck sweatshirt, so the mug and the sweatshirt make a set for the same rider. Fill it with coffee, tea or cocoa on a cold morning before chores. A funny horse girl mug like this also works for a mom, aunt or coach who spends every paycheck at the barn.
joke_a: Every horse owner knows where the money went, and this mug says it proudly: HORSE GIRL, BROKE ON PURPOSE. The Horse Girl, Broke on Purpose horse mug from Graphic Tees Co. is the funny gift for the rider, the barn mom or the friend paying the board bill with a smile.
